name: Where is my lady?
source:
Where am I? And where is my lady? I often wander when I sleep, but I've never gone this far before. Well, what should I do now?

The colorful adventure of an unlucky maid. Will she be able to return home?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111210/Where_is_my_lady/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
